mapper.select: SELECT R.*, S.USER_NAME AS SELLER_NAME, B.USER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME FROM CHAT_ROOMS R JOIN USERS S ON R.SELLER_ID = S.USER_ID JOIN USERS B ON R.BUYER_ID = B.USER_ID WHERE R.SELLER_ID = #{userId} OR R.BUYER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOMS (ROOM_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (CHAT_ROOMS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{sellerId}, #{buyerId}, #{productId}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CHAT_MESSAGES WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGES (MESSAGE_ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, SENDER_NAME, MESSAGE_CONTENT, MESSAGE_TYPE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (CHAT_MESSAGES_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{senderName}, #{messageContent}, #{messageType}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
